ido.question: A teacher inputs four marks. Use a FOR loop and IF to count how many are at least 60, then print the count.
ido.scaffold:
count = _____
for i = _____
    mark = _____
    if _____ then
        count = _____
    endif
next i
print(_____)

steps.title: Initialize the count
steps.explanation: The counter must start at zero.

steps.title: Loop and read four marks
steps.explanation: Get a fresh integer mark on every loop iteration.
steps.code:
count = 0
for i = 1 to 4
    mark = int(input("Mark?"))

steps.title: Count qualifying marks
steps.explanation: The IF decides whether this mark increases the counter.
steps.code:
count = 0
for i = 1 to 4
    mark = int(input("Mark?"))
    if mark >= 60 then
        count = count + 1
    endif

steps.title: Output after all passes
steps.explanation: Close both constructs before printing the count once.
steps.code:
count = 0
for i = 1 to 4
    mark = int(input("Mark?"))
    if mark >= 60 then
        count = count + 1
    endif
next i
print(count)

wedo.question: A PE teacher enters three race times. Count how many are less than 15 seconds and display the total.
wedo.scaffold:
fast = _____
for i = _____
    time = _____
    if _____ then
        fast = _____
    endif
next i
print(_____)

steps.title: Count matching entries
steps.explanation: For each time, only increment when the time is below 15.
steps.code:
fast = 0
for i = 1 to 3
    time = int(input("Time?"))
    if time < 15 then
        fast = fast + 1
    endif

steps.title: Complete and test
steps.code:

for i = 1 to 3
    time = int(input("Time?"))
    if time < 15 then
        fast = fast + 1
    endif
next i
print(fast)

wedo.question: Input four quiz scores, count how many reach at least 50, and display the count. Start without a detailed scaffold.
wedo.scaffold:
passed = _____
# Write FOR, IF, NEXT and output.

steps.title: Plan counting
steps.explanation: Write the whole program before reveal.

steps.title: Write the IF inside the loop
steps.explanation: Each score must be read on every pass; increment only when the condition is true.
steps.code:
passed = 0
for i = 1 to 4
    mark = int(input("Score?"))
    if mark >= 50 then
        passed = passed + 1
    endif

steps.title: Check the full structure
steps.explanation: Explain why ENDIF is before NEXT i and print is after it.

for i = 1 to 4
    mark = int(input("Score?"))
    if mark >= 50 then
        passed = passed + 1
    endif
